requirement.title: Export existing cases and area watch in headless JSON debriefs
requirement.quote: | missing persons and cases [S] | each open case; the area watch: +1 posted guard and +1 camera on the block where the person was last seen, for 3 missions; the district's security level S | a kill never found: +2 T, no Menace, close ties fear +1, the case stays open until the body is found · a found killing: −1 Standing, grief, its case closes after 3 missions · every 2 open cases raise S by 1, at most +2 |
acceptance: Headless JSON debriefs expose both existing case and area-watch collections, including empty collections when there are no entries.
Each exported collection faithfully represents all existing entries and their current values and associations, without dropping, duplicating or synthesizing consequences.
All previously emitted JSON fields retain their names, types and values for the same simulation state; adding these collections does not change existing consequence calculations.
Reading or serializing a debrief leaves simulation state, collection contents, mission progression and replay checksums unchanged; repeated reads of an unchanged state produce identical output.
Replaying the same starting state and recorded orders produces identical exported case and area-watch data while preserving existing replay results.
Exporting the collections does not advance case or area-watch durations, apply consequences again, commit a campaign result or introduce campaign persistence.
requirement.rationale: Makes existing consequence data available to headless consumers through one cohesive serializer change. Expected effort is modest because the goal specifies existing collections; compatibility and accidental mutation are the main risks. The explicit goal requires preservation, not implementation of new campaign rules. Current code inspection must establish collection shapes, existing JSON behavior and any gaps; the index and prior test claims establish none of these. Missing rulebook values or source conflicts are blockers to flag, not permission to invent values.

  "rule": "One integer per district, starting at `start` (one step short of the Hero band: Sky 2026-10-16, 'Hero is kinda the default'). At or above `hero` the district is in the Hero band, at or below `menace` in the Menace band, otherwise neutral. In a mission only acts seen or found move it: each witnessed incident of a Hero act adds one `step`, of a Menace act takes one (traceable[].standing, witness.sees), a public fight moves it once when it ends, by whom the cell fought (fight.public, Sky 2026-10-16: 'it should be per fight, and depends who you're fighting'; not capped, and a move for the drift), and a found killing moves it takedown.foundKillStanding; a missing person moves nothing. Facts along ties never move it (Sky Q6). Between missions the word does (standing.word): each person the cell helped, pressured or knocked out this mission, alive, not missing and with a tie of a kind in `word.ties`, tells those ties how a stranger treated them, once per person, not per tie: helped +`word.step`, pressured or knocked out −`word.step`; a person both helped and harmed counts as harmed (a threat outweighs a kindness). The word's net move in a district is clamped to ±`word.cap` a mission; seen and found acts are never capped. The word is a feeling, not a fact: no face, place or time and nothing about the cell goes with it, so it is no fact for word.passes, the Talker test or the investigators, and word-quiet-loyalty does not stop it. Then (standing.drift) a district where nothing moved Standing this mission (no act seen or found, in the mission or after it, and no word) moves `drift` back toward `start`, from either side, never past it. The debrief carries one Standing line per district (debrief.lines.standing) with its cause, one of `causes`: the cause that moved it most toward the net change (the earliest on a tie), `balanced` when the moves cancel, a drift, or `steady`. Heat (§06) = campaign Trail + max(0, −standing), unchanged: from the start it takes 3 net Menace steps before Standing adds Heat, and Hero never cancels Trail; its threshold is Motive's.",
